From lane_change, auto_finished_true exits HighwayMode directly (line 39) without reaching FinishState. In three of four HighwayMode substates (enter_hwy, lane_change, and one path from cruise), the auto_finished_true trigger leads to mode exit rather than termination at FinishState.
